name: source-control
description: Read repository content and open pull requests on a git hosting platform (GitHub/GitLab-style). Never includes a merge or force-push tool in this manifest on purpose — those are exactly the kind of action the human-approval-gate hook recipe in 06-agent-hooks-and-skills/hooks exists for, not something a plugin manifest should hand out as a permission string.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file's content at a given ref (branch, tag, or commit).

tools.name: open_pull_request
tools.description: Open a pull request from a branch that already has commits pushed to it. Deliberately does not accept raw file diffs to write directly — the plugin doesn't perform the commit itself, it only opens the PR once a branch already exists, keeping the actual code-writing step outside this plugin's authority.
